_comment: Operator-readable fixture of representative Polymarket × Kalshi candidate pairs.
Used by tests/test_prediction_market_semantic_pairing.py AND by the CLI flag:
The fixture is intentionally split into 'polymarket' and 'kalshi' arrays —
the scanner forms the cross-product itself.  Categories/probabilities match
the canonical advisory-only schemas; nothing here authorises execution.

polymarket.title: What price will Bitcoin hit in May?
polymarket.semantic_text:
Title: What price will Bitcoin hit in May?
Rules: Resolves YES if BTC trades at or above $150k at any point in May.
Category: crypto

polymarket.title: Will Bitcoin close above $100k on May 31?
polymarket.semantic_text:
Title: Will Bitcoin close above $100k on May 31?
Rules: Settles to the Coinbase daily close on May 31.
Category: crypto

polymarket.title: Will the Fed reduce rates at the June meeting?
polymarket.semantic_text:
Title: Will the Fed reduce rates at the June meeting?
Rules: Resolves YES on FOMC June statement reducing the target range.
Category: economy

polymarket.title: Will WTI crude close above $80 by end of June?
polymarket.semantic_text:
Title: Will WTI crude close above $80 by end of June?
Rules: Settles to the WTI front-month NYMEX close on June 30.
Category: commodities

kalshi.title: How high will Bitcoin get in May?
kalshi.semantic_text:
Title: How high will Bitcoin get in May?
Rules: Settles to the highest BTC/USD print on Coinbase between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-31.
Category: Crypto

kalshi.title: Will Bitcoin close above $150k on May 31?
kalshi.semantic_text:
Title: Will Bitcoin close above $150k on May 31?
Rules: Settles to BTC/USD close on Coinbase on 2026-05-31.
Category: Crypto

kalshi.title: Will the Fed cut rates at the June 2026 meeting?
kalshi.semantic_text:
Title: Will the Fed cut rates at the June 2026 meeting?
Rules: Resolves YES if the FOMC June 2026 statement reduces the target range.
Category: Economics

kalshi.title: Will Brent oil close above $80 by end of June 2026?
kalshi.semantic_text:
Title: Will Brent oil close above $80 by end of June 2026?
Rules: Settles to ICE Brent front-month close on June 30.
Category: Commodities

kalshi.title: Will Ethereum hit $5k in 2026?
kalshi.semantic_text:
Title: Will Ethereum hit $5k in 2026?
Rules: Resolves YES if ETH/USD trades at or above $5,000 at any point in 2026.
Category: Crypto
